parsed.post: Kept MATRIX_LR 0.08->0.06: val_bpb 1.0197 -> 0.9994 on clean shards 0-9, depth 6, batch 262144, warmup 0.05, WD 0.1. Lower LR gives a big clean gain. Next: test MATRIX_LR 0.05 to see if even lower LR continues improving depth-6 stability.
